caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mannequin-like figure dressed as a soldier, mounted on a round black base. The figure has a gray face and hands, black arms and boots with a red stripe near the top, blue pants, a red double-breasted vest or jacket with gold buttons, and a black hat. The soldier's right arm is raised upward holding a white, spear-like object, while the left arm is lowered, also holding a similar spear-like object. Both spears have a pointed triangular shape and a gradient shading suggesting a metallic appearance. Behind the main colored figure is a lightly sketched outline of the same figure in pencil, showing the same posture and objects but with minimal detail and no color.
title: Whirligig
